title: Oma
northstar: Cool, deep blue grid, precise sans-serif, expansive minimalist stillness.
autopsy:
FOLD: Nav top-left: "OMA" "OFFICE" "WORK" "SEARCH" in black caps, spaced apart. Centered white rectangle with black caps "EDO-TOKYO MUSEUM". Lower-right red-bordered white box: date "April 15th 2026" in red, then "OMA / Shohei Shigematsu Completes Site-Specific Interventions at Edo-Tokyo Museum" in red. No CTA button. Hero: full-bleed architectural interior photograph, ceiling grid with blue sky/wave projections, silhouetted visitors below; text overlays sit in upper-third and lower-right quadrant.

TYPE: Sans-serif, bold, extended width for nav and headline; body same family, regular weight. Extreme scale jump: nav/headline massive, date and article text small. All caps dominant. Tight tracking.

COLOR: Background: photographic blues and dark architecture. Text: black (nav, headline), red (#f82727) (date, article text, box border). Accent red lands exclusively on editorial box content. No other accent.

SIGNATURE: Red-bordered white editorial card floating over dark lower-right of hero, creating magazine-cover caption effect against immersive architectural photography.
description: The page prioritizes a large, atmospheric image, establishing a sense of place and scale. Text is minimal, serving to identify the subject and event, maintaining a clean and authoritative feel.
